text: The extracted crate adds eight queue assert!/assert_eq! calls and one line-release success assertion without diagnostic messages. They check runner count, idle/closed state, operation IDs and wakeup success. Each should state the expected invariant so a failure identifies the contract. Panic text in other branches is not an assertion message. This is an exact source finding in these tests, not a runtime failure or a global imported-code rewrite.
title: The new queue and line tests contain nine assertions without messages
